description: Our beloved Oregon is in peril, and as I continue to help lead the efforts for real solutions, for our working families, their communities, and the businesses that support them, more can and will be done. I’ve fought for you in our Oregon State Capitol in Salem, and I will continue to put you first in our U.S. Capitol in Washington.
